scope: One published darwin-arm64 library; not evidence for other platform binaries.
conclusions: locale_config 0.3.0 parser/data is retained and runtime-used: exact source regex bytes, machine-code pointer+length, and semantic SVG probe agree.

librsvg 2.63.2 obtains names via glib::language_names(), then Locale::invariant(), LanguageRange::from_unix(), Locale::add(); no call to locale_config current/global/user-default initialization is in the production path.
cond.rs Locale::current() occurrence is a documentation comment, not executable code.

locale_config macOS system_locale uses NSLocale/currentLocale/localeIdentifier and objc class!/msg_send! macros; required objc_getClass/sel_registerName imports and fixups are absent. This gives source plus dynamic-linkage evidence that this specific initializer route is not retained as executable code.
No uniquely attributable retained objc-foundation, objc_id, malloc_buf or block implementation was demonstrated. Cargo-selected dependencies must not be equated with proven shipped executable code.

Absence of stripped symbols is not proof of crate absence. objc_id StrongPtr can call objc_retain/objc_release, both imported by this multi-library binary, so these imports cannot uniquely attribute or exclude objc_id. Generic malloc_buf/free code can inline. Whole-crate bitwise absence remains unproven without link map/build evidence.
